notes: gpt-6.1-sol is listed by model/list but rejected for ChatGPT-account Codex: 400 'model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account'. gpt-6-astra produced no output within 40 s. gpt-5.5 also rejected. gpt-5.6-sol works and is the default (I3D_MODEL env overrides).

A fresh thread's first turn costs 11-17 s of tool/plugin startup. The server keeps a pre-started spare thread and runs a tiny warm-up turn on it, so real requests are a second turn: ~1.2-2.5 s to first line.
Back-to-back requests within ~12 s of each other may hit a still-warming spare thread and wait for it.
